_comment: Bilateral heel raise (calf raise). Camera placed to patient's side at ankle height.

metrics.name: heel_height
metrics._comment: Positive when heel rises above the ankle reference. side_aware swaps to right_ when injured_side=right.

metrics.name: ankle_angle
metrics._comment: Angle at the ankle joint. ~90 deg neutral, increases toward 140 deg at full plantarflexion.

metrics.name: hip_vertical_delta
metrics._comment: Used to detect hip_hike compensation — hip should not rise relative to knee during the raise.

phases.name: down
phases._comment: Heel flat on floor or minimally elevated.

phases.name: up
phases._comment: Heel sufficiently raised — full plantarflexion target.

form_rules.cue: Slow down — aim for 2 seconds up, hold, then 2 seconds down.

form_rules._comment: Evaluated at peak (when phase == up). If peak heel_height never reaches 0.06, fire this.
form_rules.cue: Rise higher onto the ball of your foot — push through the big toe.

form_rules._comment: Hip rising more than 4% of screen height relative to knee = compensation.
form_rules.cue: Keep your hips level — don't let one side hike up.
